_comment: Non-secret league settings. Safe to commit: a league ID identifies a league
but grants no access to it. Reading a private league still requires valid
espn_s2 and SWID cookies from an actual member, and those live only in
GitHub's encrypted Secrets, never in this file.
Any value here can be overridden by an environment variable of the same
name in upper case (LEAGUE_ID, TEAM_ID, SEASON_YEAR), which is how you
would point the tools at a different season without editing the file.
